title: Restore the disabled-policy hold assertion in the retained relay wake regression
outcome: The retained relay wake regression directly observes no mailbox prompt while federation policy is disabled, before observing delivery after re-enable.
acceptance: The public retained-head relay regression runs the wake batch while federation policy is disabled and asserts the runtime input channel is empty before enabling federation.
The same test retains successful head delivery and following user-work ordering after re-enable without adding a verification or activation prerequisite.
